system.description:
Starting at 3rd level, you learn a special Fuinjutsu technique to infuse your inner most Id, Ego and Superego into a mask of your creation and description, creating a duplicate chakra construct known as a Void Soul, a manifestation of your true self, that you can call upon for support. Your Void Soul when summoned looks like how you wish yourself to be otherwise called your ideal self with the caveat of always wearing the custom mask and being unable to take it off. Your Void Soul can be summoned as a bonus action and occupies your space alongside you. It is visible to all creatures.

Once summoned, you can command it by spending your Bonus Actions. Your Void soul uses the Statistics in the Void Soul stat block at the end of this class section; Your Void soul has the following rules.

Your Void Soul knows a number of Jutsu known equal to your proficiency bonus.

Your Void Soul can only learn jutsu which you could normally qualify for (Keywords, Hijutsu, etc.), plus one keyword that you don’t have access to (Any one nature release or medical keyword).

You can switch your Void Soul’s Jutsu known when you would gain a level.

It uses its own ability scores for the purpose of qualifying for jutsu. These jutsu are added to your known jutsu list, but you cannot cast them, only your void soul can.

Movement speed is equal to yours. If you would end your turn more than 60 feet away from your Void Soul, it is resummoned in your space.

Uses your Chakra when casting its Jutsu.

If your Void Soul would take damage, you lose hit points equal to the damage taken.

Your Void Soul has your same saving throw proficiencies.

If you and Void Soul would make a saving throw against the same effect, you only make one save suffering the effects only once.

If the Void soul would take damage, you do not need to make a concentration check.

You can dismiss your Void Soul as a bonus action on your turn or when you fall unconscious.

Finally, your Void Soul does not have Ability scores like a normal creature, but instead only Ability Modifiers. You may distribute the following Ability modifiers and apply it to your Void Soul giving each modifier to a chosen ability once (+4, +3, +2, +2, +1, +0).
